scope: Exploratory conditional resource model. Technology anchors plus explicit unsynthesized logic/cost assumptions; not dollar cost, measured TDP or physical signoff.
primary_budget: normalized system cost; area, power and interface limits are additional constraints

memory.fields: capacity, bandwidth, latency, shoreline, read/write energy, background range; HBM background uses range midpoint. GB are decimal.
memory.qualification: MemExplorer study parameters, some experimental and some projected. Not measured on our hardware.

compute_energy.qualification: Energy anchor only; our array timing/logic area is not that implementation or node. Sweep 0.5x/2x.

array.source: H2-LLM section 7.1 and MemExplorer Table III
array.qualification: Published systolic-array/frequency examples motivate geometry; replication counts are design variables.

provenance.unverified: Logic area coefficients, PHY depth, normalized memory cost ratio, base power, SRAM power reserve, 512 GB/s SRAM port budget per array, 32 outstanding DRAM transfers, bandwidth efficiency, vector/control overhead and achievable clock require independent calibration. Interface limit is a package envelope, not a routed floorplan.
